migration_steps.activity: Establish PQC migration program governance, assign a technical lead, and document the DoD mandate requirements (NIST-standardized ML-KEM and ML-DSA only, quantum-safe VPN by 2027).
prerequisites: Copy of DoD mandate and acceptance criteria
Identification of stakeholders (network, security, procurement, legal)

migration_steps.activity: Perform cryptographic inventory of the IKEv2/IPsec VPN estate: identify all endpoints, RSA-2048 certificates, DH Group 14 usage, firmware versions, and vendor models.
prerequisites: Read-only access to VPN configuration management systems

migration_steps.activity: Evaluate the vendor PSK appliance claim: document that 256-bit PSK is not vulnerable to Shor's algorithm but is not a NIST-standardized PQC algorithm and does not satisfy the DoD requirement for ML-KEM/ML-DSA; record as non-compliant for the mandate.
prerequisites: DoD mandate text specifying ML-KEM and ML-DSA

migration_steps.activity: Issue formal RFI to current VPN vendor and alternative vendors requesting confirmed ML-KEM and ML-DSA support in IKEv2/IPsec, including firmware versions, interoperability evidence, and FIPS 140-3 validation status.
Assess vendor RFI responses: distinguish confirmed capabilities from roadmap claims; reject any vendor without confirmed ML-KEM/ML-DSA support or credible delivery before 2027.

Select target VPN solution and architecture: confirm ML-KEM for key establishment and ML-DSA for authentication/signatures in IKEv2; define hybrid vs. pure PQC mode based on vendor confirmed support and DoD acceptance.
prerequisites: DoD clarification on hybrid vs. pure PQC acceptance

migration_steps.activity: Procure PQC-capable VPN hardware/software and required licenses; include spares and support contracts.
Build non-production PQC VPN lab environment and train network team on ML-KEM/ML-DSA configuration, IKEv2 PQC payloads, and troubleshooting.
Conduct interoperability testing between contractor PQC VPN and DoD VPN gateways using ML-KEM and ML-DSA; validate certificate chains, IKEv2 negotiation, and fallback behavior.
prerequisites: DoD test gateway access and test certificates

migration_steps.activity: Obtain DoD approval of the PQC VPN configuration and interoperability test results; confirm acceptance of hybrid or pure PQC mode.
prerequisites: Test results package submitted to DoD

migration_steps.activity: Develop production migration plan, rollback plan, and change management documentation; schedule production changes outside the Dec 1–Jan 15 change freeze.
Pilot production migration on a limited set of VPN tunnels during an approved maintenance window after the change freeze (post Jan 15, 2026).
Full production rollout of PQC VPN across all contractor-to-DoD tunnels, with monitoring and rollback capability.
Decommission legacy RSA-2048/DH Group 14 VPN configurations and update cryptographic inventory and documentation.
prerequisites: DoD confirmation that legacy tunnels are no longer required

migration_steps.activity: Conduct post-migration audit, update security policies, and establish continuous monitoring for PQC algorithm compliance through 2027.

blockers.blocker: Vendor PSK appliance does not support ML-KEM or ML-DSA.
blockers.reason: DoD mandate explicitly requires NIST-standardized PQC algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA); PSK with 256-bit entropy is not a NIST-standardized PQC algorithm and does not satisfy the mandate.
blockers.resolution_required: Select a VPN solution with confirmed ML-KEM and ML-DSA support in IKEv2/IPsec, or obtain vendor commitment with verifiable evidence and delivery before 2027.

blockers.resolution_required: Obtain written vendor confirmation with firmware version, release date, and interoperability test evidence; otherwise migrate to an alternative vendor.

blockers.resolution_required: Confirm estate size and vendor pricing; prioritize software/firmware upgrades over hardware replacement where possible; seek additional funding if needed.

algorithm_roles.ML-KEM: Post-quantum key establishment (encapsulation) for IKEv2 key exchange, replacing DH Group 14 to protect against Shor's algorithm.
algorithm_roles.ML-DSA: Post-quantum digital signatures for IKEv2 authentication and certificate signatures, replacing RSA-2048 signatures to protect against Shor's algorithm.
